press_references.value: Raptor Comply Provides Enterprise-Level Compliance Without Scaling Headcount

product_launches.description: Raptor Maps launched Raptor Comply, an automated NERC compliance platform for generator owners and operators across North America, aiming to cut NERC CIP program setup and admin costs and reduce manual evidence collection. The platform supports wind, solar, storage, hydro, and natural gas facilities and is also available via MSSPs.

press_references.value: Raptor Maps Closes $35 Million Series C Financing to Drive Next-Generation Solar Asset Management Solutions

product_launches.description: Raptor Solar Sentry is a software product that orchestrates solar operations and maintenance work by people and robotics.

overview_description.description: Raptor Maps offers a platform that analyzes data from various sources to improve solar asset performance. The service automates visual inspections and provides an intuitive interface for managing solar plants. It enables technicians to access critical information and track their work efficiently, even in remote areas.

about_short_description.short_description: Raptor Maps provides performance intelligence solutions for solar asset management.

product.name: Raptor Solar Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing solar assets, workflows, operational data, inspections, and performance analytics across the asset lifecycle.

product.name: Raptor Solar Sentry
product.description: An inspection intelligence solution that analyzes solar imagery to identify photovoltaic system anomalies and support maintenance prioritization.

product.name: Raptor Solar DG
product.description: A solar management solution for distributed-generation portfolios that organizes site data, inspections, issues, and maintenance workflows across many smaller assets.

product.name: Solar Inspections Analytics
product.description: Analytics software for reviewing solar inspection data, locating anomalies, and turning inspection findings into actionable asset-management information.

product.name: Solar Site Digital Twin
product.description: A digital representation of a solar site that connects physical asset locations with inspection, construction, operational, and performance information.

product.name: Solar Construction Monitoring
product.description: A service and workflow solution for tracking solar construction and installation progress, documenting site conditions, and coordinating project issues.
